intro: This quest is the second leg of a treasure hunt devised by the enigmatic pirate Captain Sanders across Westfall. Following instructions recovered from an abandoned seaside footlocker, searchers must venture east away from the coast to find another clue hidden inside an old barrel near ruined stonework.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The clue to the treasure reads: Good work, matey! Now ye need to head due east. East up the bluffs, east to the road. Look for the ol' chimney ruins near the side of the road. There you'll find an old barrel with your next clue.
